guideTitle: The Best Monitor Arm Desk Mounts: Clamp, Grommet or Wall
metaDescription: A monitor arm is only as good as its mount and weight range. We compared eight single arms on clamp, grommet and wall mounting, load, screen size and VESA.
introParagraphs: Choosing a monitor arm starts with how it attaches. A C-clamp grips the desk edge; a grommet mount passes through a hole in the desk; a wall mount avoids the desk entirely but needs drilling into a stud. Check your desk's edge thickness and whether it has, or can take, a grommet hole.

Then match the arm's weight range to your monitor's weight without its stand, and confirm the VESA pattern. Budget arms here top out around 20 to 26 lb; the TitanLift handles 44 lb and 49-inch screens.
Our comparison is based on published specifications, not hands-on testing. Prices ranged from about $20 to $240 at the time of writing.

ergotron-lx-monitor-arm-clamp-grommet.summary: Ergotron's LX for monitors up to 34 inches and 7 to 25 lb, with clamp or grommet mounting.
ergotron-lx-monitor-arm-clamp-grommet.description:
The Ergotron LX is the established choice for a single monitor up to 34 inches, including curved and ultrawide panels, rated for 7 to 25 lb with VESA 75 or 100mm, and it mounts by clamp or grommet.

It costs several times more than the budget arms here at the time of writing; what the extra buys is Ergotron's track record and wide weight range.
cons: Costs far more than budget arms
ergotron-lx-monitor-arm-clamp-grommet.bestFor: A heavier monitor up to 34 inches, used daily.
ergotron-lx-monitor-arm-clamp-grommet.skipIf: Your monitor is light and standard size; the HUANUO FlowLift costs a fraction.

huanuo-flowlift-clamp-grommet-mount.badge: Best Budget Clamp and Grommet Arm
huanuo-flowlift-clamp-grommet-mount.summary: A HUANUO arm for 13- to 32-inch monitors, 4.4 to 19.8 lb, with clamp and grommet bases included.
huanuo-flowlift-clamp-grommet-mount.description:
The HUANUO FlowLift covers standard monitors from 13 to 32 inches and 4.4 to 19.8 lb, with both a C-clamp and grommet base in the box, plus tilt, swivel and rotation.

It was under $35 at the time of writing. Heavier or larger screens need a higher-rated arm.
cons: VESA pattern not stated in summary
huanuo-flowlift-clamp-grommet-mount.bestFor: Standard monitors on any desk edge or grommet.
huanuo-flowlift-clamp-grommet-mount.skipIf: Your monitor is over 19.8 lb; the WALI or Ergotron LX is rated higher.

ergear-tool-free-vesa-clamp-mount.summary: An ErGear arm for 13- to 34-inch screens up to 19.8 lb, with tool-free VESA and cable management.
ergear-tool-free-vesa-clamp-mount.description:
The ErGear is the least expensive arm here: it holds 13- to 34-inch screens up to 19.8 lb, with a tool-free VESA plate (up to 100 x 100mm), a clamp mount and built-in cable management.

It was under $20 at the time of writing. A grommet option isn't mentioned.
ergear-tool-free-vesa-clamp-mount.bestFor: A simple arm for a light monitor on a tight budget.
ergear-tool-free-vesa-clamp-mount.skipIf: You need a grommet mount; the HUANUO FlowLift includes one.

wali-vesa-clamp-mount.summary: A WALI clamp arm for 13- to 34-inch screens up to 26.4 lb, VESA 75/100mm.
wali-vesa-clamp-mount.description:
The WALI carries more weight than the other budget arms, up to 26.4 lb, for 13- to 34-inch screens (WALI suggests regular screens up to 32 inches), with a VESA 75/100mm plate and clamp mount.

It was under $20 at the time of writing. A grommet option isn't mentioned in the summary.
wali-vesa-clamp-mount.skipIf: You want grommet mounting; the HUANUO FlowLift Pro includes it.

huanuo-flowlift-pro-tool-free-clamp-grom.badge: Best Tool-Free Clamp and Grommet Arm
huanuo-flowlift-pro-tool-free-clamp-grom.summary: HUANUO's FlowLift Pro for 13- to 32-inch screens up to 19.8 lb, with tool-free VESA and both mounts.
huanuo-flowlift-pro-tool-free-clamp-grom.description:
The FlowLift Pro adds a tool-free VESA attachment to the FlowLift formula: 13- to 32-inch screens up to 19.8 lb, clamp and grommet bases included, with tilt, swivel and rotation.

It was slightly cheaper than the standard FlowLift at the time of writing.
huanuo-flowlift-pro-tool-free-clamp-grom.bestFor: Easy monitor attachment on any desk.
huanuo-flowlift-pro-tool-free-clamp-grom.skipIf: Your screen is heavy; the WALI or Ergotron LX is rated higher.

huanuo-titanlift-dual-clamp-mount.badge: Best for Heavy and Ultrawide Screens
huanuo-titanlift-dual-clamp-mount.summary: A reinforced aluminum arm for screens up to 49 inches and 44 lb, with dual C-clamp.
huanuo-titanlift-dual-clamp-mount.description:
The TitanLift is the arm for big screens: rated up to 49 inches and 44 lb, aluminum, with a dual C-clamp base, and HUANUO describes a reinforced design. It has a five-year warranty in other listings.

VESA is 100 x 100mm maximum, so check larger monitors' patterns, and the dual clamp needs clear desk edge.
huanuo-titanlift-dual-clamp-mount.skipIf: Your monitor is under 20 lb; a budget arm is enough.

ergotron-lx-pro-clamp-grommet.summary: Ergotron's LX Pro in white, for monitors up to 34 inches and 4 to 22 lb.
ergotron-lx-pro-clamp-grommet.description:
The Ergotron LX Pro is the premium version in white, for flat, curved or ultrawide monitors up to 34 inches from 4 to 22 lb, with clamp or grommet mounting and VESA 75 or 100mm.

Its upper weight limit is lower than the standard LX's 25 lb, and it costs more; the white finish is the main reason to choose it.
ergotron-lx-pro-clamp-grommet.bestFor: A white desk setup with a light to mid-weight monitor.
ergotron-lx-pro-clamp-grommet.skipIf: You need up to 25 lb; the standard LX is rated higher.

ergotron-lx-wall-mount.summary: Ergotron's LX wall-mount arm for monitors up to 34 inches, 7 to 25 lb; requires stud installation.
ergotron-lx-wall-mount.description:
The Ergotron LX wall mount frees the desk entirely: the arm attaches to a wall rather than the desk, holding monitors up to 34 inches from 7 to 25 lb, in polished aluminum.

It requires installation into a wall stud, so it involves drilling and suits spaces where that's allowed. It was the most expensive arm here at the time of writing.
ergotron-lx-wall-mount.bestFor: Desks that can't take a clamp, where wall mounting is possible.
ergotron-lx-wall-mount.skipIf: You rent or can't drill; a clamp or grommet arm avoids wall work.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Clamp, grommet or wall; several arms include both clamp and grommet bases.
Compare with the arm's range, including any minimum (Ergotron LX 7 lb).
Most here support 75/100mm; larger screens may need other patterns.
Heavy monitors need a solid desk; glass or hollow-core tops may not suit clamps.

faq.a: A clamp needs a solid desk edge; a grommet needs a hole but keeps the edge clear. The HUANUO FlowLift models include both.

faq.q: How do I know my monitor's weight?
faq.a: Use the weight without the stand from the manufacturer's specifications.

faq.q: What if my monitor is too light?
faq.a: Some arms have a minimum; below it, a gas spring may not hold position.

faq.q: Does the wall mount need drilling?
faq.a: Yes, it installs into a wall stud.
For a light, standard monitor, often; check load and VESA.

bottomLine: For a standard monitor, the HUANUO FlowLift Pro and FlowLift include clamp and grommet mounts for little money, and the WALI handles more weight under $20. The Ergotron LX is worth paying more for a heavier 34-inch screen used every day.
For heavy ultrawides, the TitanLift is rated to 44 lb. The Ergotron wall mount clears the desk entirely, if you can drill into a stud.
